$comment: Schema for load_ext extension actions. Self-contained and closed: re-declares every property action.v1 would otherwise provide and rejects any undeclared field, on itself and on its own payload (cpt-frontx-dod-gts-type-provider-infra-schema-ownership). load_ext carries no history intent — that applies only to mount_ext and unmount_ext.

type.$comment: Self-reference to this action's schema type ID

target.$comment: Lifecycle actions target domains only — the extension is identified via payload.subject

subject.$comment: Extension ID that this action targets

payload.$comment: Action payload with required extension reference
